intent: Deduplicate domain-qualified language-visible scientific quantity operations against already selected D10 laws before any candidate promotion. A Lisp function definition is not automatically a new 10-bit resident.

donors.role: Lisp-owned finite quantity and dimension algebra
Seven exact BIPM SI defining constant records are DATA, not seven callable residents
Versioned translation/review protocol already substantially selected in D10

review_rows.semantic_law: construct new immutable unit by adding the exponent collections from two valid unit records
review_rows.falsifier: metre^1 multiplied by metre^-1 yields dimensionless; result must not alter either source unit

review_rows.semantic_law: construct a unit by merging left exponents with sign-negated right exponents
review_rows.falsifier: (metre/second)*second yields metre dimensions; wrong unit schema must BLOCK, not silently use NIL

review_rows.semantic_law: multiply exact numeric values then compose associated dimensions; preserve typed quantity result rather than bare scalar
review_rows.falsifier: (2 metres)*(3 seconds) yields numeric six with metre*second dimensions and does not mutate operands

review_rows.semantic_law: divide exact numeric values then compose left unit with reciprocal right unit, preserving quantity type
review_rows.falsifier: (6 metre*second)/(3 second) yields numeric two metres; division by zero must retain existing numeric error law

conclusion: All four operations already compose existing Lisp-owned arithmetic/dimension laws. HOLD until a concrete independent observer demonstrates irreducible, substrate-independent behavior absent from D1-D9 and 625 already selected D10 meanings. Preserve all 625/1024 inventory numbers.
